pokedexEntries.di: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

pokedexEntries.prl: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

pokedexEntries.pt: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

pokedexEntries.hgss: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
